description: A portable ADS-B receiver's GDL 90 bytes (Garmin 560-1058-00 Rev A) read into a picture the engine holds between reads (receiver_read's, AIM 4-5-7, 4-5-8, 4-5-9), answering only its small part: the receiver's state, own ship and the traffic it hears whole, and for the FIS-B texts and NEXRAD only how many there are and a revision of each, a new one whenever a read changed them, so the host asks for a field's reports or the NEXRAD again only then. The phones hold the picture in a ReceiverSession (engine/bindings/ffi), which answers each read in this shape, so the hundreds of kB of FIS-B are never sent across each second; asked by name, the picture handed over is held for the one read, its revisions counted from 0. Traffic is for seeing, not avoiding (AIM 4-5-7).

data.description: The bytes received since the last read (whole UDP datagrams), Base64 (RFC 4648).

at.description: Now, Unix s: when the bytes came.

picture.description: The picture to hold for the read, or null for an empty one.

texts.description: How many FIS-B texts the picture holds.

blocks.description: How many NEXRAD blocks the picture holds.

traffic_revision.description: A new count each read that changed the traffic to merge: the targets, or whether a receiver has been heard at all.

texts_revision.description: A new count each read that changed the FIS-B texts (one sent, or one dropped as no longer heard).

nexrad_revision.description: A new count each read that changed the NEXRAD blocks.
